content.text: The text surveys major Civil War campaigns and battles. Port Hudson resisted Banks; Gettysburg ended Lee’s invasion after three days of intense fighting and Pickett’s failed charge, while Vicksburg fell. Chickamauga was a Confederate victory largely because Thomas held firm, but Grant’s victories at Lookout Mountain and Missionary Ridge secured Chattanooga. Grant’s 1864 campaigns against Lee at the Wilderness, Spotsylvania, North Anna, Cold Harbor, and Petersburg produced enormous Union losses but steadily exhausted Confederate resistance. Sherman outmaneuvered Johnston, captured Atlanta, and marched through Georgia to Savannah, later advancing through the Carolinas. Sheridan defeated Early in the Shenandoah Valley, including at Cedar Creek. Farragut captured Mobile Bay, and Union engineers saved Porter’s Red River fleet with Bailey’s dam. During the narrative, John moved to the bedroom.
